title: Bencao Gangmu (Compendium of Materia Medica)
summary: The Ming physician Li Shizhen (1518-1593) compiled this encyclopedia of plants, animals, minerals and other substances believed to have medicinal properties, finishing the first draft in 1578 after 27 years. The first printed edition, the Jinling edition, was engraved at Nanjing in 1590. UNESCO registered it as Memory of the World documentary heritage.

uncertainty.note: Start is completion of the first draft (UNESCO, Wellcome); end is the 1590 engraving of the first edition (Wellcome). Other sources give 1596 for printing; not used.

as_recorded.value: The first draft was completed in 1578

where.modern_name: Nanjing, Jiangsu, China (Jinling, place of first printing; proxy pin)

importance.justification: UNESCO describes it as listing and describing all plants, animals and minerals believed medicinal; inscribed in Memory of the World.
